Yes, this matches what I wanted. A named saved search should remember the complete query, including included and excluded tags, and reapply it with one click.

Tying it to the view where it was created is the clearer behaviour, especially because archived bookmarks are intentionally separate. When opened later, it should calculate the matches from my current bookmarks rather than preserving a frozen list, so newly saved bookmarks that match will appear too. Persisting these saved searches between visits is also right.
